name: Victor Morales
summary: Victor M. Morales (born November 15, 1949) is an American educator and former politician who was the Democratic Party's nominee for the 1996 United States Senate election in Texas in 1996. Morales was a 46-year-old Vietnam War veteran and civics teacher at Poteet High School in Mesquite, Texas when his students dared him to run for Senate and he did.
